description: This script generates test data for CRL (Certificate Revocation List) handling, including creating certificates, CRLs, and various test scenarios for CRL validation.

methods.name: DictUnion
methods.description: Merges two dictionaries, with b overwriting a in case of key conflicts.

methods.name: Der2Ascii
methods.description: Converts DER bytes to ASCII representation using der2ascii tool.

methods.name: Ascii2Der
methods.description: Converts ASCII to DER bytes using ascii2der tool.

methods.name: Ascii2OpensslDer
methods.description: Converts ASCII to DER and formats as OpenSSL DER string.

methods.name: CreateCert
methods.description: Creates an X.509 certificate with specified parameters, including CA hierarchy and extensions.

methods.name: SignAsciiCRL
methods.description: Generates a CRL in ASCII format, signed by a specified signer.

methods.name: MakePemBlock
methods.description: Encodes DER data into PEM format with headers and footers.

methods.name: WriteStringToFile
methods.description: Writes string data to a specified file path.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores certificate and CRL data into a PEM file with associated metadata.
